pan-p01.speaker: author (devotional voice)
pan-p01.question: The whole duty is one act: pride offered on the Lord's feet; all else denied, and only immediate pleasure asked.
premises: What is true of my doing = one duty = offering of pride.
My all = this offering; anything other does not exist, for me.
Renunciation already accomplished (tyaktvā) grounds the plea: be pleased.
pan-p01.inference: Total offering of pride; plea for immediate pleasure.
uncertainties: Whether prasāda means 'pleasure' or 'grace' is unresolved.

pan-p02.speaker: author (devotional voice)
pan-p02.question: Speech becomes the offering: the word crying victory at the threshold is itself to become bliss-giving; having Maheśa as protector is to become being protected.
premises: Praise at the door is the offering.
The cry 'jaya jaya maheśa' is both act and instrument.
Status (sanātha) turns into request (make possessed of a protector).
pan-p02.inference: Speech becomes bliss-giving; request to be made protected.
uncertainties: Whether śivadā means 'bliss-bestowing' or 'Śiva-giving' is unresolved.

pan-p03.speaker: author (devotional voice)
pan-p03.question: Five refusals charged — speak, see, hear, come, support — and scripture converts the charge into doctrine: the Lord is sense-free.
premises: Five refusals charged: speak, see, hear, come, support.
Scripture converts the charge into doctrine: the Lord is sense-free.
pan-p03.inference: Complaint becomes doctrine: denial becomes declaration.
uncertainties: Whether the turn to śruti is sincere resolution or ironic resignation is unresolved.

pan-p04.speaker: author (devotional voice)
pan-p04.question: Against the silence stand two testimonies — the guru's word and fitting scriptural assurance — whose force wipes away piled-up reasonings; with doubt dissolved, the feet of the heart-sky Lord.
premises: Two testimonies: guru's word and fitting scriptural assurance.
Their force wipes away (not refutes) heaped reasonings.
Doubt-cloud dissolved, touch the feet of the heart-sky Lord.
pan-p04.inference: Two testimonies dissolve doubt; touch of feet follows.
uncertainties: Whether guru's word and scripture are two distinct sources or one twofold source is unresolved.

pan-p05.speaker: author (devotional voice)
pan-p05.question: Long dwelling-with and total grace received, yet repeated forgetting; the only request is no more absence.
premises: Long dwelling-with and total grace received.
uncertainties: prāsuvatkāyaḥ is obscure; glossed 'whose body has attained it'.

pan-p01.plain_english: Whatever I have truly done, O Lord — no duty of mine goes beyond this: my pride, laid at Your lotus feet with devotion. This is my all; I know there is nothing other. So, casting all else aside — quickly, O protector of the helpless, O ocean of compassion — be pleased with me!
pan-p01.sanskrit_cite: yatsatyam tu mayā kṛtam mama vibho kṛtyam tu na ataḥ param yat manmānam aiśapādakamale bhaktyā mayā eva | arpitam sarvasvam ataḥ eva etat itarat na asti eva jānāmi ataḥ tyaktvā kṣipram anāthanātha karuṇāsindho prasannaḥ bhava

pan-p02.plain_english: O Maheśa, at Your door let this charming speech of mine flash forth, exceeding all: 'Victory, victory to Maheśa!' — faultless, unceasing. Let this very speech, auspicious, be bliss-giving to me forever. O Lord, O giver of refuge, make me — whose protector is Maheśa — possessed of a protector!
pan-p02.sanskrit_cite: maheśa tvaddvāri sphuratu rucirā vāk atitarām mama eṣā nirdoṣam jaya jaya maheśa iti satatam | śivā sā eṣā vāṇī bhavatu śivadā mahyam aniśam maheśanātham mām śaraṇada sanātham kuru vibho

pan-p03.plain_english: You speak not, O best-limbed one; You look not upon me, wretched as I am. My entreaty, made in many ways, You hear not; You come not into my mind. Fallen into the pit amid transmigration's ocean, I am mostly left unsupported — yet scripture truly declares You devoid of speech, sight, hearing, feet and the like!
pan-p03.sanskrit_cite: brūṣe na uttamāṅga paśyasi na mām etādṛśam duḥkhitam vijñaptim bahudhā kṛtām na śṛṇuṣe | na āyāsi manmānase saṃsārārṇavagartamadhyapatitam prāyeṇa na ālambase vākcakṣuḥśravaṇāṅghriṇādirahitam tvām āha satyam śrutiḥ

pan-p04.plain_english: From the guru's word — by the force that wipes away the fabric of heaped-up reasonings — and from the assurance told, fittingly, out of regard for scripture: when the cloud of doubt has dissolved, let me touch the feet of the Lord, whose splendor shines in the sky of the heart — like the sun, the conqueror of darkness.
pan-p04.sanskrit_cite: guroḥ vākyāt yukti-pracaya-racana-unmārjana-vaśāt samāśvāsāt śāstram prati samucitāt api kathitam | vilīne śaṅkābhre hṛdayagaganodbhāsimahasaḥ prabhoḥ sūryasya iva spṛśatu caraṇān dhvāntajayinaḥ

pan-p05.plain_english: Much time dwelling with You has passed — alas, in this very moment! What, what has not been done by You for me, for the sake of serving the excellent guru! Again and again I, whose body has attained the incomparable divine plane — yet indeed I forget You. Therefore, by You, let there be no further staying-away!
pan-p05.sanskrit_cite: yātaḥ tvatsahavāsataḥ bahutaraḥ kālaḥ vata asmin kṣaṇe kim kim vā na kṛtam tvayā varagurūpāsānimittena me vāram | vāram aham punar nirupamām divyām bhuvam prāsuvatkāyaḥ tvām kila vismarāmi yat ataḥ stheyam na bhūyaḥ tvayā

essence: The whole duty is one act: pride offered on the Lord's feet; all else denied, and only immediate pleasure asked.

rasa.dominant: śṛṅgāra/bhakti (devotion as love-in-separation from the Lord)
rasa.sthayibhava: rati/bhakti transformed by viraha into karuṇā (compassion-plea)
rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is devotion (bhakti) expressed as total offering (sarvasva); helplessness (anātha) is vyabhicāri, integrated into the plea for pleasure (prasāda).

essence: Speech becomes the offering: the word crying victory at the threshold is itself to become bliss-giving; having Maheśa as protector is to become being protected.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is devotion expressed as praise (jaya); the threshold (dvāra) is vibhāva, speech (vāk) is the offering. No sorrow of absence; rasa is joy of praise.

essence: Five refusals charged — speak, see, hear, come, support — and scripture converts the charge into doctrine: the Lord is sense-free.

rasa.dominant: karuṇa (compassion-plea) shaded by adbhuta (wonder at doctrine)
rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is devotion (bhakti) in the mode of complaint (vijñapti); the vyabhicāri is despair (duḥkha), integrated by the turn to śruti's declaration of sense-freedom.

essence: Against the silence stand two testimonies — the guru's word and fitting scriptural assurance — whose force wipes away piled-up reasonings; with doubt dissolved, the feet of the heart-sky Lord.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is devotion (bhakti) in the mode of assurance (samāśvāsa); the vyabhicāri is doubt (śaṅkā), dissolved (vilīna) into the touch of feet.

essence: Long dwelling-with and total grace received, yet repeated forgetting; the only request is no more absence.

rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is devotion (bhakti) in the mode of confession (vismara admitted); the vyabhicāri is forgetting, integrated into the plea for presence (stheyaṃ na bhūyas).

lines: Whatever I have truly done, O Lord, is this one duty and nothing beyond: my pride, offered at Your lotus feet in devotion.
This is my all; nothing else do I know. Having cast all else aside — quickly, O protector of the helpless, ocean of compassion — be pleased.
pan-p01.sanskrit_cite: yatsatyaṃ tu mayā kṛtaṃ mama vibho kṛtyaṃ tu nātaḥ paraṃ yanmanmānamaiśapādakamale bhaktyā mayaivārpitam | sarvasvamata evametaditarannāsyeva jānāmyatastyaktvā kṣipramanāthanātha karuṇāsindho prasanno bhava
notes: prasāda as ‘pleased’ (pleasure reading); grace reading open — see argmap

lines: O Maheśa — at Your door let my charming speech flash forth, faultless: ‘Victory, victory to Maheśa,’ unceasing.
Let this auspicious speech bring me bliss forever. O giver of refuge, make me — whose protector is Maheśa — protected, O Lord.
pan-p02.sanskrit_cite: maheśa tvaddvāri sphuratu rucirā vāgatitarāṃ mamaiṣā nirdoṣaṃ jaya jaya maheśeti satatam | śivā saiṣā vāṇī bhavatu śivadā mahyamaniśaṃ maheśanāthaṃ māṃ śaraṇada sanāthaṃ kuru vibho
notes: śivadā as bliss-bringing; Śiva-giving reading open

lines: You speak not, O Fair-limbed; You look not on wretched me, hear not my oft-made plea, nor come into my mind.
Fallen into the pit mid-ocean of becoming, I go mostly unsupported — yet scripture truly declares You without speech, sight, hearing, feet, and the rest.
pan-p03.sanskrit_cite: brūṣe nottamāṅga paśyasi na māmetādṛśaṃ duḥkhitaṃ vijñaptiṃ bahudhā kṛtāṃ na śṛṇuṣe nāyāsi manmānase | saṃsārārṇavagartamadhyapatitaṃ prāyeṇa nālambase vākcakṣuḥśravaṇāṅghriṇādirahitaṃ tvāmāha satyaṃ śrutiḥ
notes: śruti turn rendered straight; sincere-vs-ironic open — see argmap

lines: By the guru’s word — whose force wipes clean the heaped fabric of reasonings — and by assurance fittingly told regarding scripture:
when the doubt-cloud melts, let me touch the feet of the Lord, whose splendor blazes in the heart’s sky like the sun that conquers darkness.
pan-p04.sanskrit_cite: gurorvākyādyukti-pracaya-racana-unmārjana-vaśātsamāśvāsācchāstraṃ prati samucitādapi kathitam | vilīne śaṅkābhre hṛdayagaganodbhāsimahasaḥ prabhoḥ sūryasyeva spṛśatu caraṇān dhvāntajayinaḥ
notes: guru’s word + assurance kept as two sources; one-twofold-source reading open

lines: Much time with You has passed — alas, in this very moment! What has not been done by You for me, for the sake of serving the excellent guru!
Again and again, I — whose body has reached the peerless divine plane — yet I forget You. So by You let there be no more staying away.
pan-p05.sanskrit_cite: yātastvatsahavāsato bahutaraḥ kālo vatāsmin kṣaṇe kiṃ kiṃ vā na kṛtaṃ tvayā varagurūpāsānimittena me | vāraṃ vāramahaṃ punarnirupamāṃ divyaṃ bhuvaṃ prāsuvatkāyastvāṃ kila vismarāmi yadataḥ stheyaṃ na bhūyastvayā
notes: prāsuvatkāyaḥ obscure; follows L2’s neutral gloss

lines: Whatever I have truly done, O Lord: one duty, nothing beyond —
my pride, offered at Your lotus feet, in devotion.
This is my all, nothing else I know; all else cast aside —
quickly, O protector of the helpless, ocean of compassion, be pleased.
pan-p01.sanskrit_cite: yatsatyaṃ tu mayā kṛtaṃ mama vibho kṛtyaṃ tu nātaḥ paraṃ yanmanmānamaiśapādakamale bhaktyā mayaivārpitam | sarvasvamata evametaditarannāsyeva jānāmyatastyaktvā kṣipramanāthanātha karuṇāsindho prasanno bhava
notes: prasāda as ‘pleased’ (pleasure reading); grace reading open — see argmap

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: total offering (sarvasva; FIRST VERSE — sets the house voice: intimate-address, plain diction, dash-hold, end-weight plea; owner verdict required). Abhinavagupta frame: sādhāraṇīkaraṇa generalized (‘my pride’ thins to ‘pride offered’ only where Sanskrit generalizes — manmāna kept ‘my pride’ where Sanskrit points); dhvani rank kept — the plea names nothing beyond the act, vyaṅgya (grace hoped, not stated) unstated. Rows firing: 1 (imperative bhava held line-final), 5 (śloka tread, bank: hymn tread for śloka-source), 7 (vocatives vibho/anāthanātha/karuṇāsindho each kept fresh), 9 (nātaḥ paraṃ/itaranāsti double-negation engine → ‘nothing beyond / nothing else’). Close: ‘be pleased’ (prasanno bhava; pleasure-reading per L3 note, grace open). Rejected: ‘laid down’ for offered — killed: slant on arpitam; merging vocative clusters — killed: row 7; ‘be gracious’ — killed: L3 note freezes pleasure. Read aloud: WHAT-ever I have TRU-ly DONE, o LORD: ONE-du-ty, NO-thing be-YOND — MY-pride OFF-ered … be PLEASED.

reads_against.argmap: The whole duty is one act: pride offered on the Lord's feet; all else denied, and only immediate pleasure asked. → Total offering of pride; plea for immediate pleasure.
c1_essence: The whole duty is one act: pride offered on the Lord's feet; all else denied, and only immediate pleasure asked.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śṛṅgāra/bhakti (devotion as love-in-separation from the Lord)

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: victory cry (jaya doubled). Abhinavagupta frame: anubhāva outward — the cry IS the visible sign of rati-sthāyin; refrain staging (bank: Gitagovinda dhruvapada — the cry isolated as its own line, verbatim, never reworded). Rows: 1 (imperatives sphuratu/bhavatu/kuru each end-weight their clause), 3 (protector-chiasmus maheśanāthaṃ→sanāthaṃ kept as vise-grip), 6 (jaya jaya anchor), 7 (vocatives line-initial/final), 9 (Maheśa chiming thrice), 4 (sphuratu rucirā shimmer → ‘flash forth, faultless’ f-echo, costs nothing). Close: ‘protected, O Lord’ (sanāthaṃ kuru + vibho gathered). Rejected: single Victory — killed: doubling IS the cry; ‘glory to Maheśa’ — killed: jaya=victory, anchor verbatim; ‘make me safe’ — killed: breaks the chiasmus. śivadā bliss-reading per L3 note, Śiva-giving open. Read aloud: o ma-HE-śa — AT your DOOR … ‘VIC-to-ry, VIC-to-ry to ma-HE-śa’ — un-CEAS-ing.

reads_against.argmap: Speech becomes the offering: the word crying victory at the threshold is itself to become bliss-giving; having Maheśa as protector is to become being protected. → Speech becomes bliss-giving; request to be made protected.
c1_essence: Speech becomes the offering: the word crying victory at the threshold is itself to become bliss-giving; having Maheśa as protector is to become being protected.

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: the charge (five refusals). Abhinavagupta frame: karuṇa-sthāyin carried by anubhāva-catalogue (the refusals listed ARE the feeling showing); śruti-turn rendered straight — sincere-vs-ironic held open per UNC (tipping either way kills a reading; vighna rule: importing irony the Sanskrit only suggests would wall the sahṛdaya from one whole rasa). Rows: 1 (āha placed late — ‘declares’ carries the turn), 7 (uttamāṅga kept after first verb, mirroring brūṣe nottamāṅga), 9 (na-anaphora → ‘not’-anaphora; doctrine-catalogue answers with ‘without’-anaphora — complaint-music converted into doctrine-music, which IS the verse’s move), 10 (śruti left standing, no gloss). Close: ‘and the rest’ — the ādi-catalogue refusing to close IS the doctrine. Rejected: ironic tip — killed by UNC; trimming refusals — killed: five ARE the charge; closing on ‘You’ — killed: weak landing, Sanskrit lands on śrutiḥ/āha. Read aloud: YOU-speak-NOT … YOU-look-NOT … YOU-hear-NOT — yet SCRIP-ture TRU-ly de-CLARES.

reads_against.argmap: Five refusals charged — speak, see, hear, come, support — and scripture converts the charge into doctrine: the Lord is sense-free. → Complaint becomes doctrine: denial becomes declaration.
c1_essence: Five refusals charged — speak, see, hear, come, support — and scripture converts the charge into doctrine: the Lord is sense-free.
reads_against.c1_rasa: karuṇa (compassion-plea) shaded by adbhuta (wonder at doctrine)

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: doubt dissolving (vilīne). Abhinavagupta frame: vyabhicāri-dissolution (śaṅkā melting) staged as the rupture — piled reasonings one breath, melted cloud the next; śānta-close enacted (row 12: falling cadence on ‘darkness’, long vowels, still image — the metaphysics of the ending, not decoration). Rows: 1 (spṛśatu late — ‘let me touch’ before the simile), 2 (yukti-pracaya-racana-unmārjana compound unpacked down the line-break; bank: Ingalls moon-drops unpacking), 8 (vowel arc melts→blazes), 12 (śānta-fall). Close: ‘the sun that conquers darkness’ — darkness last, conquered. Rejected: merging two sources — killed: UNC keeps guru-word and scripture two; cutting sun-simile — killed: vibhāva does the settling; ‘lifts’ for vilīne — killed: melts, not lifts. Read aloud: BY the GU-ru’s WORD … WHEN the DOUBT-cloud MELTS … LIKE the SUN that CON-quers DARK-ness.

reads_against.argmap: Against the silence stand two testimonies — the guru's word and fitting scriptural assurance — whose force wipes away piled-up reasonings; with doubt dissolved, the feet of the heart-sky Lord. → Two testimonies dissolve doubt; touch of feet follows.
c1_essence: Against the silence stand two testimonies — the guru's word and fitting scriptural assurance — whose force wipes away piled-up reasonings; with doubt dissolved, the feet of the heart-sky Lord.

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: confession (forgetting admitted). Abhinavagupta frame: karuṇa-sthāyin with śānta acceptance — the plea asks only absence-ended, not presence-described (deixis thinned exactly where Sanskrit thins: stheyaṃ na bhūyas = no-more-staying-away, no positive image imported). Rows: 1 (optative stheyam kept as plea — ‘let there be’ retained; close lands on ‘away’, absence itself ringing), 7 (tvayā instrumental force → ‘So by You:’ colon landing), 9 (kiṃ kiṃ + vāraṃ vāraṃ both kept doubled). Close: ‘no more staying away’ (absence-reading per L3 note; ‘presence’ close would flip the frozen reading). Rejected: undoubled ‘What has not been done’ — killed: kiṃ kiṃ doubles; softening ‘alas’ — killed: vata IS the admission-gasp; resolving prāsuvatkāyaḥ past L2 — killed: obscure kept neutral. Read aloud: MUCH-time WITH-you has PASSED — a-LAS … WHAT — WHAT has NOT been DONE … YET i for-GET you — NO-more STAY-ing a-WAY.

reads_against.argmap: Long dwelling-with and total grace received, yet repeated forgetting; the only request is no more absence. → Confession and plea for presence.
c1_essence: Long dwelling-with and total grace received, yet repeated forgetting; the only request is no more absence.
